name: Ashlet · Gremlet #35
description:
A charcoal dragonling with glowing cracks. Hiccups little sparks when it laughs.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Ashlet in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
